name: linggen
description: Linggen for Claude Code — one local program, one MCP server (`linggen`, /mcp), twelve tools: durable cross-host memory (five memory tools), agents that take delegated work, and browser control in your own Chrome, all from the Linggen engine. Per-turn memory recall built in, and /linggen:config points this host at a Linggen on another machine. Installs Linggen (background download) on first session start.
